story.fullStory:
The Moody Blues's "Go Now" reached #10 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Go Now" is a song composed by Larry Banks and Milton Bennett and first recorded by Bessie Banks, released as a single in January 1964.

The song peaked at #10 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.

Go Now was released in 1965.
